finding.title: Canonical actor ID is compared directly with the real host task author
finding.impact: Every actual Source-author audit in validate_authority fails before prepare/run; reviewer peer captures fail by the same rule.
finding.suggested_change: Explicitly bind each canonical codex actor to its exact host task path for author/reviewer peer records. Validate canonical actor, actual host author, metadata/session/offset bytes, and artifact digest together.
finding.required_control: Use this real author peer capture as a positive Source control; reject foreign task authors and wrong canonical actor mappings. Keep actual Root tool-pair validation separate.
finding.author_control_gap: The 69 controls verify actual Root tool pairs; authority shape controls replace actual_audit with an in-memory mock. No actual peer-delivery positive control was exercised.
